# bytes of SPEC-09 CONF-16 (box 10 default BX10-29). One line per export: its name, the length

# the ones SPEC-03 5.6 states. compiler/tests/golden_suite.py checks that cint_ref writes these
# bytes, and that cintc writes them for `both` (public_records.ci), `read_number` and `parse_u`
# (parse.ci), and `paired` (public_views.ci).
